name: Cloud Giant

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The giant has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: The giant's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: Detect Magic, Fog Cloud, Light. 3/Day Each: Feather Fall, Fly, Misty Step. 1/Day Each: Control Weather, Telekinesis.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two Morningstar attacks or two Rock attacks.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) Bludgeoning damage.

description: Cloud giants dwell in castles hidden amid the clouds, courtly and capricious hosts whose innate magic lets them vanish in a blink and shape the weather to their whims.
